title: Use broad genre-style prompt directions (e.g., dejavu planecrash, thriller) in…
content: Use broad genre-style prompt directions (e.g., dejavu planecrash, thriller) in Seedance2.5 to get surprisingly good results even without detailed prompting.
tips: Use broad genre-style prompt directions (e.g., dejavu planecrash, thriller) in Seedance2.5 to get surprisingly good results even without detailed prompting.

es.content: Usa indicaciones de prompt amplias basadas en géneros (por ejemplo, dejavu planecrash, thriller) en Seedance2.5 para obtener resultados sorprendentemente buenos incluso sin un prompting detallado.

fr.content: Utilisez des indications de prompt larges, orientées genre (par ex. dejavu planecrash, thriller) dans Seedance2.5 pour obtenir des résultats étonnamment bons, même sans prompt détaillé.

ja.content: Seedance2.5では、詳細なプロンプトを使わなくても、dejavu planecrash、thriller のような幅広いジャンル指向の prompt を使うだけで、驚くほど良い結果が得られます。

ko.content: Seedance2.5에서는 상세한 프롬프트 없이도, broad genre-style prompt directions(예: dejavu planecrash, thriller)를 사용하면 놀라울 정도로 좋은 결과를 얻을 수 있습니다.

pt.content: Use direções de prompt amplas e baseadas em gênero (por exemplo, dejavu planecrash, thriller) no Seedance2.5 para obter resultados surpreendentemente bons, mesmo sem prompts detalhados.

zh.content: 在 Seedance2.5 中使用宽泛的类型风格提示方向（例如 dejavu planecrash、thriller），即使不进行详细提示，也能获得出人意料的好结果。
